text.es: Fina: Bianca es solo una amiga. Y ha formado parte de un momento de mi vida muy complicado, mucho. Pero mi corazón te pertenece a ti. Y yo ya no me imagino una vida sin estar contigo. Marta: Yo tampoco me imagino ya la vida sin estar contigo.
text.en: Fina: Bianca is just a friend. And she was part of a very complicated time in my life, very. But my heart belongs to you. And I can no longer imagine a life without being with you. Marta: I can't imagine life without being with you either.
